title: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) Governance & Services
description: Role of PACS in credit delivery, inputs supply, and rural financial services under NABARD and Ministry of Cooperation guidelines.
source_name: Ministry of Cooperation, Govt of India
content:
Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) form the grassroots tier of the short-term cooperative credit structure in India, operating directly at the village level to serve farmers and rural artisans.

Core Functions of PACS:
1. Short-Term Crop Loans: Providing timely credit to farmer-members for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and meeting seasonal operational expenses.
2. Medium-Term Loans: Financing agricultural equipment, irrigation pumpsets, cattle purchase, and land development.
3. Deposit Mobilization: Accepting savings and fixed deposits from village members to encourage local thrift.
4. Supply of Agricultural Inputs: Distributing certified seeds, subsidized fertilizers, and farm implements directly to farmers.
5. Computerization and Multi-Service Centers (MSCs): Under the National Computerization of PACS initiative, PACS are being converted into Multi-Service Centers offering warehouse facilities, custom hiring centers, and digital financial services.

Governance & Membership:
- Every farmer residing in the operational area of the PACS is eligible for membership upon subscribing to share capital as per society by-laws.
- The Managing Committee elected by member-shareholders oversees day-to-day administration and loan sanctioning in adherence to state cooperative society acts and model by-laws.
